Karammya — logo identity (2019).

A monogram exploration that ran the gamut — a fine-line signature, an Art-Deco letterspaced wordmark, and a gilded ginkgo 'k' — before settling on a single refined mark: the 'k' threaded with a gold ginkgo over a quiet deco 'KARAMMYA'.

Logo identity — Anirudh Kapoor. A·67.
